name: pink-disco-ribbon
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished portrait bridal party invitation card ONLY, flat front-facing artwork filling the entire image edge to edge, aspect ratio 2:3. No scene around the card, no tabletop, no mockup shadows, no collage scraps outside it, no mood board, no website UI. Tasteful vintage stationery designed by a skilled human illustrator, soft candy pink uncoated paper with fine raspberry ink line art, minimal slight risograph imperfection. Small hand-drawn disco ball suspended at top center, thin playful ribbon frame around edges with small asymmetric bows, two small four-point sparkles, tiny coupe glasses illustration along bottom corners. Large airy center devoted to exquisite editorial typography. Exact text: at top small 'YOU’RE INVITED', center small italic 'Ana’s', then large sweeping vintage script on two lines 'Bridal Party', beneath small 'Girls. Glitter. Champagne.', bottom small '25 JULY 2027 · 16:00' and 'TBILISI'. Rich dark raspberry lettering for strong readable contrast. Refined pink bridal stationery, restrained illustrations, natural printed texture. Avoid generic AI fantasy art, shiny 3D, photorealistic props, excessive decoration, fake gradients, any extra words. This is a new standalone card design.

name: pink-fashion-bow
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Finished portrait bridal invitation card, 2:3 ratio, flat print design edge to edge. Card only: no tabletop, surrounding background, mockup, perspective, cast shadow, vision board or UI. Vintage 1960s pink fashion stationery, charming human-made ink illustration. Pale blush paper, hot raspberry pink ink, thin double border with rounded decorative corners. Tiny illustrated bow at top, elegant fashion silhouette of a vintage pink high heel at bottom right, miniature heart at bottom left, abundant blank space. Typography is the star: bold curving seventies serif 'BRIDAL' above 'PARTY' occupying central third, balanced editorial spacing, a gentle arch for small header 'HELLO, GORGEOUS'. Exact remaining text: small italic 'Ana’s', centered 'A little pink. A lot of love.', '25 JULY 2027 · 16:00', 'TBILISI'. Two-tone pink flat screenprint with subtle authentic ink texture, clean professional layout. No glitter, photorealistic collage, 3D, neon gradients, artificial overdetailing or extra text.
